crypto_headlines.title: BTC closes its 7th straight red week, first time since 2022
crypto_headlines.summary: BTC's weekly close came in at $61,144, still above this year's lowest weekly close of $59,486. It is down over 30% since last month.

crypto_headlines.title: Spot Bitcoin ETFs see $1.79B in weekly outflows
crypto_headlines.summary: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs had $1.79B in outflows last week, the largest weekly outflow in 21 weeks.

crypto_headlines.title: Bitcoin bounces from around $56K to about $61K
crypto_headlines.summary: BTC was near $61,216 Monday morning (+0.9% over 24h), with ETH at $1,722, SOL at $72.50, DOGE at $0.0557 and PYTH at $0.0511, per CoinGecko around 8:30 AM ET.

crypto_headlines.title: Binance funding flips negative, Coinbase premium negative for 60 days
crypto_headlines.summary: Binance perpetual funding rates turned negative, and the Coinbase Bitcoin premium has stayed negative for 60 straight days.

crypto_headlines.title: Arthur Hayes ties further BTC downside to Nasdaq weakness
crypto_headlines.summary: Hayes warns $50K could be tested if stocks keep falling.

crypto_headlines.title: CYBER token hit by suspected bridge exploit
crypto_headlines.summary: 5.21M CYBER (about $1.1M) was minted on Solana and released from the Ethereum bridge. Upbit and Bithumb froze CYBER deposits and withdrawals.

doginal_news.title: The first DDLTCG Championship starts today
doginal_news.summary: Participants check in on Discord at 10am ET, and spectators can watch games online. Swiss-style matchups run all week, with knockouts Saturday, per the community.

doginal_news.title: Countdown to DDMIAMI
doginal_news.summary: The community is counting down to DDMIAMI, where the Doginal Dogs Legends TCG championship takes place, about 15 days out as of Nov 22.

doginal_news.title: "Name a better community than Doginal Dogs"
doginal_news.summary: A community wave asking people to name a better community than Doginal Dogs, reposted by @doginaldogs.

doginal_news.title: PIRB: Pyth is built into the new financial world
doginal_news.summary: PIRB says Pyth is built into the fabric of the new financial world: perps, prediction markets, AI agents and distribution.

doginal_news.title: LayerZero ATLAS gets the full Pyth data stack
doginal_news.summary: A community post notes LayerZero ATLAS is getting access to the full Pyth data stack, including Pyth Pro and Pyth Indices.

doginal_news.title: PYTH nearly flat over 200 days while BTC fell about 25.5%
doginal_news.summary: Per @gandreou007, PYTH is down only about 0.5% over the last 200 days, while BTC lost about 25.5% over the same stretch.

notes: The DDLTCG Championship kicks off today with Discord check-in at 10am ET. Other Doginal Dogs and Pyth items above are community posts and reposts.
